---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: Angel Legrand
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
district_2015 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, score_2015 = rla_score)
district_2023 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, score_2023 = rla_score)
score_change <- district_2015 |>
  inner_join(district_2023, by = c("district_id", "district_name", "state")) |>
  mutate(score_change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, score_change) |>
  collect()
state_scores <- tbl(con, "state_scores")
state_2015 <- state_scores |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, score_2015 = rla_score)
state_2023 <- state_scores |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, score_2023 = rla_score)
state_change <- state_2015 |>
  inner_join(state_2023, by = c("stateabb", "state_name")) |>
  mutate(score_change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, score_change) |>
  collect()
print(state_change)
```

```{r}
district_change_plot_data <- score_change |>
  collect() |>
  rename(rla_change = score_change) |>
  mutate(change_direction = case_when(
    rla_change > 0 ~ "Positive",
    rla_change < 0 ~ "Negative",
    TRUE ~ "No change"
  ))

ggplot(district_change_plot_data, aes(x = rla_change, fill = change_direction)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "District Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("Districts with scores in both years:", scales::comma(nrow(district_change_plot_data))),
    x = "Change in reading score (2015 to 2023)",
    y = "Number of districts",
    fill = "Change",
    caption = "Positive values indicate improvement; negative values indicate decline."
  )
```

```{r}
state_2015_plot <- tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, score_2015 = rla_score)
state_2023_plot <- tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, score_2023 = rla_score)

state_change_plot_data <- state_2015_plot |>
  inner_join(state_2023_plot, by = c("stateabb", "state_name")) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    change_direction = if_else(score_2023 >= score_2015, "Improved", "Declined"),
    state_name = forcats::fct_reorder(state_name, score_2023)
  )

ggplot(state_change_plot_data, aes(y = state_name)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = score_2015,
      xend = score_2023,
      yend = state_name,
      color = change_direction
    ),
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.12, "inches"))
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = score_2015), color = "gray", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = "Reading scores from 2015 to 2023, ordered by 2023 score",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Direction of change",
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores; arrows point to 2023 scores."
  )
```
